purpose: Shorten time from Relay approval to first verified revenue without taking payment or promising delivery before approval.

delivery_claims: Provider comparison using observed benchmark evidence available for the approved task class.

Developers actively paying for structured search/research APIs
Agent builders with recurring machine-search workloads

Enable simplest viable Stripe A$49 founding-pilot checkout; do not alter benchmark scope or claims.
Contact qualified waitlist leads first, prioritised by monthly spend and recurring workload.
Record payment only from Stripe-observed evidence as verified revenue.

founder_handoff.blocking_action: Provision the dedicated scoped ELTEX credential outside model-visible surfaces and inject it into the network-capable runner secret store while wallet balance remains zero.
founder_handoff.after_handoff: Run machine-observed C01-C12. Funding and paid benchmarks remain prohibited until signer conformance passes.

evidence_state.signer_blocker: No operator-connected signer/scoped credential in external runner secret store; no machine-observed C01-C12 results.
evidence_state.paid_benchmark_blocker: Real non-synthetic paid exact-task benchmark cannot run until signer boundary passes and controlled funding is permitted.

truthfulness: This artifact prepares the commercial path only. It is not Relay approval, a customer commitment, revenue, paid benchmark evidence, or signer-conformance evidence.
